outcome_definition: Precision outcome = the coefficient of variation (CV = 100*SD/Mean) of the reported VAF across replicates at a fixed target VAF, under four CLSI EP05-A3 conditions (within-run, interoperator, between-day, total). It is a QUANTIFICATION spread, not a qualitative call and not a partition-model prediction. Values are printed as published; the four 0.1%-VAF cells do NOT reproduce CV = 100*SD/Mean from the printed SD and are not corrected.
